name: job-autopilot
description: Find IT jobs with freehire and auto apply in a real Chromium window, using your own profile and resume.

interface.shortDescription: Find jobs with freehire and auto apply in Chromium.
interface.longDescription: Tell the agent which role and where. It searches live IT job postings with freehire, shortlists the ones that fit your profile, and fills in and submits each application on the employer's own page in a visible Chromium window, with a local log and a screenshot per application.
defaultPrompt: Apply to remote React developer jobs in Europe.
Find senior Python jobs in Germany with visa sponsorship.
